name: British Railway
desc:
NEW UPDATE! Take control of the dual-mode Class 387 "Electrostar" from the city into the countryside on the new Fairholt Branchline, BR's first electrified branchline! Drive new liveries for the recently-added Class 43 "HST" and Mk3 Coaches.

Welcome to British Railway!

🚆 Take control of a range of detailed trains!
🎫  Guard a friend's train and check tickets!
🌳  Explore the expanding network as a passenger!

➥ Check out the in-game changelog to see what's new
➥ Consider playing in a private server with friends if you're experiencing lag or crashes (free with Plus!)
➥ Join the group to keep up with development

British Railway is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the Department for Transport, nor any Train Operating Companies.
